_WARNING: THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR VOLLEY GEOMETRY. Do NOT edit dimensions inside Fusion 360 — user parameters there are document-scoped and will silently drift across the nine documents. Change a value here, then regenerate the affected document from script. Fusion is authoritative for geometry and fit only; analysis/*.py remains authoritative for mass and performance. Fusion-computed masses are proxies (solid-copper stator, solid-aluminium CubeSats, steel standing in for NdFeB) and are deliberately excluded from this file.

DIFF THIS AGAINST THE REPO COPY BEFORE MERGING — the original may carry provenance fields or analysis-script cross-references not reproduced here.

_PROVENANCE.coordinate_frame: x = firing axis, positive toward the muzzle. Origin x=0 at the ESPA flange aft mating face. y = lateral (P = +y port, S = -y starboard). z = vertical, z=0 at the stator mid-plane.

envelope.reconciliation_note: SUPERSEDES the 1825 x 516 x ~1030 figure in EMOCD_CAD_Master_Plan.md. That earlier value was measured on the now-superseded single-file model (MOCD_Deployer_Assembly_v1, closed and archived) BEFORE the enclosure existed, before the ESPA interface was rebuilt from a flat plate into a ring flange, and before the cassette septum/pin corrections. Length and width grow by skin clearance plus 2 mm shell (1825->1839, 516->530). CAUTION: the height change (1030->940) is larger than skin thickness explains — the lower bound is now set by the flange ring (z=-230) and the upper by the radiator (z=+710); the earlier model's height is believed to have included annotation-plane text and a differently-measured follower-motor stack. FLAGGED FOR RE-VERIFICATION.
envelope.espa_grande_conflict: Longest dimension exceeds ESPA Grande's ~1270 mm class limit by ~44%. Open problem P9 — host claim must be re-scoped or the machine repackaged.

stator.end_turns_note: Omitted — correct for field and force computation, WRONG for packaging. Real racetrack ends wrap beyond the 90 mm active depth and are not in the envelope.
stator.layer_count_decision: OPEN — single vs two-layer is an unmade electromagnetic design decision. Single layer as drawn.

sled.provisional_note: The 6 mm chassis is a first-pass stiffness-driven design (0.0115 mm deflection under 3.7 kN inter-array attraction -- superseded, A12 gives 2.69 kN, so the deflection is conservative -- against a +/-0.05 mm gap budget) with NO structural FEA behind it. Sled mass from this geometry contradicts the 4.86 kg assumed by mass_properties.py and drives exit velocity. Open problems P5/P8. ANSYS analysis A4 must close this before any number downstream is locked.

magazine._document: EMOCD_Magazine_Cassette (one document, inserted twice; second instance is a 180-degree rotation about z through x=210.25, NOT a mirror — Fusion rejects mirror transforms for external references)
magazine.shell_construction_decision: OPEN — drawn as closed 4 mm panels (upper bound, and the mounting surface the silicon-steel septa need). mass_properties.py assumes a 6% fill open frame (lower bound). The ~4.8 kg difference is a real design decision, not an error.
magazine.gate_pin_diameter_note: 6 -> 9 mm, 2026-08-10 by validation/A22_gate_resize.md. D6 was sized against a quasi-static 25 g case; the governing case is random vibration through the 109 Hz mode, where D6 gives a negative margin at Q = 30. D9 gives +0.45 there and stays positive across Q = 10..30 for 11 g. See P37.

gen6_drive._document: Built by cad/build_gen6.py. ADR-032: the payload is accelerated directly by cold gas along a rail the host stage provides. There is no mover, no stator, no brake and no return stroke. ADR-034: the stroke is the host stage's whole usable acceleration length, and the charge pressure fell to hold the exit velocity while the peak acceleration halved.
gen6_drive._source: A49 (stroke and charge pressure), A41 (chamber), A42 (reservoir and fill), A38 (tip-off ceiling and cradle preload), A37 (stage class and the 25 g payload cap). BOTH velocity numerators are carried. exit_velocity_m_s_zero_friction is the gas work alone; exit_velocity_m_s_at_friction_allowance subtracts A41's full tolerable seal friction scaled over the longer stroke. The gap between them widened from 5.00 % to 15.38 % at ADR-034 -- friction scales with contact length while shot work saturates. P67, P78. ADR-035 states the material, which was named nowhere until 2026-08-20 -- A49 computed the tube at 2700 kg/m3 and precharged.py sizes the chamber at 7800, and A49 band 7 passed at 1.140 kg without knowing it was choosing. Aluminium on mass: A59 found strength, stiffness and buckling all indifferent between the metals, and A58 found it is MATCHING the piston and bore that removes the 10.79 um differential, not which metal. A61 band 7 found a 16.000 mm ISO 6432 stock bore costs 0.00 % on the SEAL specification, but it moves the charge pressure and every number derived from it, so it is left as a separate decision rather than bundled here. The 473 K ceiling FORECLOSES steam -- A63 found none of 108 steam design points reaches it.

gen6_store._source: A41 bands 2-6, A42 bands 1-6, A43 bands 2-8, and A56, which SIZED it at ADR-034's charge pressure rather than scaling it. 3.46 L against A43's 9.55 at 50 bar -- the bottle falls 63.8 % where the gas falls 54.55 %, because a lower target pressure lets it be drawn further down. A43's finding survives: conduction gives 8873 s against the 1200 s cadence, 7.39x, so the no-relaxation figure is still the physically right end. Store 3.1216 kg, which is 24 % BELOW the 4.10 kg ADR-034 quoted from A49's scaling -- falsifier 2 does not fire, P82 closed. The last fill takes 11.516 s against a 10 s window and that fails at A43's point too -- P87.

gen6_trim._document: Built by cad/build_gen6.py. ADR-033: a short stator at the muzzle end, energised after the gas has finished, correcting the velocity the gas actually produced. It never throws the payload.
gen6_trim._source: A55 bands 4 and 6, which resized it. A48's 39.7 mm carried 0.323 m/s against A44's dispersion over a 2.18 m stroke; at ADR-034's 8.0 m the same model needs 1.1543 m/s and 144.01 mm -- P83, confirmed and closed. The section is 1.800 % of the stroke, against A48's 1.822 %, so it grew in exact proportion. PEAK POWER IS ESSENTIALLY UNCHANGED at 28.6 kW: the force per metre is fixed by A2's thrust constant and A1's sheet current, so the section gets longer rather than harder to drive. THE PULSE STORE THAT FEEDS IT IS STILL NOT SIZED -- ADR-033 falsifier 1, P77.
